thread:
Lia Chen: Quick sync — benchmark webinar (Tue 11am PT). Final checklist for registration page, Zoom setup, recording, and post-event lead routing. Key asks: captions ON, cloud recording + local backup, 24h edit window, HubSpot ‘hot lead’ trigger, and two short highlight clips within 48h.
Sam Ortiz: Got it. I can update reg page copy and add timezone detection. Do we want optional session tracks (prod vs infra) in form?
Lia Chen: Yes — add a dropdown for "track" and a hidden field for lead_source (utm). Keep form to 3 fields max.
Viv Patel: Zoom settings I recommend: auto-record to cloud, enable automatic live transcripts, require registration (so we get registrant emails), enable join before host OFF. Also set passcode.
Mike R: Ops note — we should enable alternate host (Jules) in case host laptop dies and pre-upload an RTMP fallback to S3 if livestream needed.
Jules: I'll be alt host. Also will run a 30m greenroom 30m prior. Can someone confirm we have captions vendor if Zoom captions look flaky?
Lia Chen: @jules good call. Plan: Zoom auto-caption + Otter.ai live captions integration as backup. If Otter fails, we fallback to native captions and mark transcript for manual QC.
OpsBot: Reminder: enable cloud recording storage retention = 72 hours before auto-delete (we will archive to S3).
Sam Ortiz: Reg page copy draft (snippet):
```
Join Redwood Inference for a 45-min benchmark walkthrough — live demos, cost/latency tradeoffs, and customer Q&A. Choose your track: Product or Platform. Recording and highlight clips will be sent to registrants within 48 hours.
```
Viv Patel: Zoom advanced settings (copy to paste):
```
- Host video ON, participant video OFF at join
- Auto-recording: Cloud (Files: recording.mp4, transcript.vtt)
- Live transcript: ENABLE (language: English)
- Alternative host: jules@redwood.ai
- Require registration: YES, approve automatically
- Meeting passcode: auto-generated
- Waiting room: OFF (we'll manage by role)
```
Mike R: Recording copies & pipeline: cloud -> 1) auto-transcode (mp4) -> 2) S3 archive (raw) -> 3) clips pipeline (trim by timestamps) -> 4) HubSpot email assets. I’ll stash the S3 path in the event object.
Lia Chen: Post-event lead routing: hot lead = attended AND job_title contains (engineer OR infra OR product) OR company in target_list. Hot leads should get 1-1 demo nurture via SDR within 24h. Warm leads get nurture sequence.
Sam Ortiz: Can we attach a short post-event survey link in the 48h replay email? 3 questions max. I’ll wire HubSpot with a property "webinar_survey_score" for segmentation.
Jules: Greenroom checklist for 30m out: mic check, screen share demo, disable email notifications, confirm alt host ready, captions test.
Viv Patel: Small ask — add a 30s "what you'll learn" clip at start of recording for social promos. Editorial: 0:30-1:00 highlight.
Mike R: I'll set a workflow in HubSpot: on recording published -> send "replay+survey" to registrants (48h delay) -> if click AND attended -> tag hot_lead. I'll share workflow ID after it's created.
Lia Chen: Risk log: if Zoom recording missing -> Ops to pull local backup from Jules within 6h, else escalate to infra for RTMP ingestion. Also redact any PII before publishing.
OpsBot: Action logged: archive_rule=cloud->s3->immutable-archive, contact=jules, sla=6h.
Sam Ortiz: Copy owner: Sam. HubSpot owner: Mike R. Ops owner: Jules. Promo assets: Viv.
Lia Chen: Great — final ask: everyone please react :thumbsup: if you can own the item you were assigned and confirm by EOD today. I'll run the greenroom and post-event plan doc after confirmations.
Jules: :thumbsup: confirmed.
Mike R: :thumbsup: setting workflow now.
Viv Patel: :thumbsup: assets in progress.
Sam Ortiz: :thumbsup: reg page done, linking to this thread.
Lia Chen: Thanks team — see you in greenroom. :eyes:
